resource_roles_basis: Inherited catalog/preview audit, not a fresh full-text reread of all 27 PDFs in this build.

learning_design.knowledge: Markdown; selected Speak Japanese knowledge/video immediately followed by shadowing its examples.
learning_design.vocabulary: Topic/event lists with new and reused items; app owns drills.
learning_design.grammar: Names/references from bunpou/Minna when useful; do not invent IDs.
learning_design.practice: Dialogue and grouped sentence shadowing, full and role-swapped, plus one Live AI context node per stage.
learning_design.cumulative: Read the preceding two actual lessons and relevant older content when authoring; roadmap order is advisory, not proof lessons exist.
learning_design.authorship: Books, external research and original AI-authored knowledge/dialogue all contribute; factual support and dialogue authorship remain distinct.
